page.title: Support
page.description: Ask the Veltrio team for help. Owners see every ticket from the company; everyone else sees their own.
page.emptyDescription: When something isn't working or you have a question, open a ticket and we'll reply here and by email.

form.title: New support ticket
form.description: Tell us what's happening. We reply here and by email.
form.subject: Subject
form.bodyHint: Include what you tried and what you expected, and a booking or plate number if it's about one.

ticket.notFoundDescription: It may belong to someone else on your team, or the link is wrong.

notice.open: Veltrio has your message. We'll reply here and by email.
notice.waiting_on_customer: Veltrio replied. Answer below, or close the ticket if everything is sorted.

details.idHint: Quote it if you contact Veltrio another way.

attachments.hint: Up to 5 files, 10 MB each: images, PDF, text or CSV.
attachments.pending: Wait for the files to finish uploading, or remove the ones that failed.

refused.type: {{name}} can't be attached. Use an image, PDF, text or CSV file.
refused.count: A message can carry up to 5 files.
